title: FBI-UAP-D014, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 1-1, Western United States Event, 2023

pages.image_type: color digital photograph with composite elements
pages.description: A nighttime desert landscape scene showing a straight dirt or gravel road receding toward the horizon at the center of the frame. The road is flanked by scrubby vegetation, grasses, and desert plants including what appears to be a yucca on the left. Dark silhouetted hills or low mountains rise on both sides of the road, framing a gap where a faint band of pale yellow-orange twilight glows near the horizon. The sky above is deep blue to nearly black with scattered stars and faint clouds. In the upper right portion of the sky hovers a glowing orange-red circular object resembling a moon or orb, and to its left are three small red dots arranged in a horizontal row.

observations.claim: A straight light-colored road runs from the foreground to the center horizon
Dark silhouetted hills flank both sides of the road
A glowing orange-red circular orb appears in the upper right sky
Three small red dots are arranged in a row to the left of the orange orb
The sky is dark blue with visible stars and a band of pale twilight near the horizon
Desert scrub vegetation and grasses line both sides of the road
No legible text is present in the image
